answer: Pinewood Federal Credit Union is in our e-payoff network, so we send your payoff to them the same day rather than within the usual 2 business days. Yes, two things come out of your payment: the $99 home pickup fee, and the loan payoff itself, so you receive whatever is left over. Keep making your loan payments until Pinewood confirms the payoff. If they end up receiving an extra payment, they will refund it to you directly.
